title: Ambasthala : un lieu construit par une énigme
purpose: Use the mango-riddle tradition and the place-name Ambasthala to show how narrative, landscape and royal intelligence are fused in later memory without treating the story as material proof.

zoom_excursion.local_payoff: The conversion is staged as a test of the king's intelligence rather than as a miracle.

content.takeaway: The rock is evidence for a remembered place in 2024; the mango episode is evidence for how conversion is narrated, not a contemporaneous record of the encounter.
